quickAnswerHtml: Mia is a One MICHELIN Star restaurant in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026, in Sukhumvit 26 (Khlong Toei). Budget around THB 2,500, book through SevenRooms online reservation, and get there via BTS Phrom Phong

blocks.html:
Mia is a One MICHELIN Star restaurant (Thailand 2026) tucked inside a house on Soi Attha Kawi 1, off Sukhumvit 26 — and it's one of the most charming stories in Bangkok's fine-dining scene, because it's run by a chef duo. Chef Top Pongcharn Russell handles every savoury course, while chef Michelle Goh takes charge of dessert as pastry chef. That split gives a meal at Mia two distinct personalities that hand off to each other seamlessly: the first half is savoury courses built on modern European technique applied to Asian ingredients, and the second half is dessert that isn't just an afterthought but a highlight in its own right. MICHELIN has kept the star on this restaurant for several years running, and it held onto it again in 2026 — which says a lot about how consistent both chefs' standards are.

The menu to aim for is Taste of Mia, an eight-course seasonal tasting menu at around THB 6,900 net per person, that walks you from chef Top's savoury courses through to a full finish of chef Michelle's desserts. If you want something a little lighter on the wallet, there's a six-course dinner at THB 3,950, or you can come for the weekend lunch — a five-course menu for just THB 2,500, which is a very approachable entry point into a MICHELIN-starred restaurant. What really sets Mia apart from restaurants at the same level is its full eight-course vegetarian and vegan tasting menu (around THB 5,900), built as a genuinely separate menu rather than just stripping the meat out of the regular one. If you're bringing a friend or family member who doesn't eat meat, this is an answer that's hard to find elsewhere in Bangkok.

The house setting makes a meal here feel warmer than a hotel dining room, which suits both celebration dinners and big dates. The restaurant is open for dinner Friday through Tuesday, 17:00-21:00, and for lunch only on Saturday-Sunday, 12:00-14:00, closed Wednesday-Thursday — a trap that catches people off guard often enough, so plan your day carefully before you head over. Booking runs through the SevenRooms system via the official site, miarestaurantbkk.com, and it's also sold as packages on Hungry Hub. Weekend dinner seatings and the Saturday-Sunday lunch fill up first, so once you've locked in a date, book right away to be safe.

blocks.name: Mia
blocks.descHtml:
Budget at Mia comes in three tiers: the Saturday-Sunday five-course lunch at THB 2,500 is the best value for trying a MICHELIN-starred restaurant for the first time, a six-course dinner at THB 3,950, and the full eight-course Taste of Mia tasting menu at around THB 6,900 net per person. Vegetarian/vegan guests get a separate full eight-course tasting menu at around THB 5,900. Book through the SevenRooms system via the official site miarestaurantbkk.com, or call +66 98 862 9659 / email reservation@miarestaurantbkk.com — packages are also available on Hungry Hub. The seatings that sell out first are Friday-Saturday-Sunday dinner and the weekend lunch, so book at least one to two weeks ahead if you're set on those days.

The restaurant is in a house on Soi Attha Kawi 1, off Sukhumvit 26, in the Khlong Toei area, near BTS Phrom Phong but about a 15-minute walk — a motorbike taxi or ride-hail from the station is the more comfortable option. Hours: dinner Friday-Tuesday 17:00-21:00, lunch only on Saturday-Sunday 12:00-14:00. Easy way to remember it: the restaurant is closed Wednesday-Thursday, so don't plan a visit on either of those two days.
